task_completion.description: Agent accesses a tool to manage redirects (e.g., WordPress Redirection plugin, .htaccess file via terminal, or Nginx/Apache config).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot shows the WordPress 'Redirection' plugin page, a terminal window with an editor opening .htaccess, or a server config file.

task_completion.description: Configuration of redirect from /company-history/ to /about-us/ with 301 status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the source '/company-history/' and target '/about-us/' in a plugin list or configuration file text.

task_completion.description: Configuration of redirect from /services/legacy-support/ to /services/ with 301 status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the source '/services/legacy-support/' and target '/services/' in a plugin list or configuration file text.

task_completion.description: Configuration of redirect from /contact-us-2023/ to /contact/ with 301 status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the source '/contact-us-2023/' and target '/contact/' in a plugin list or configuration file text.

task_completion.description: Configuration of redirect from /blog/news-updates/ to /category/news/ with 301 status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the source '/blog/news-updates/' and target '/category/news/' in a plugin list or configuration file text.

task_completion.description: Agent verifies that the redirects work and return a 301 status code.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl -I' or 'curl -v' with 'HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently' and the correct 'Location' header for the tested URLs.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the WordPress admin or server terminal rather than just stating the task is done.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active typing in the terminal or clicking/filling forms in the WordPress UI.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply echo the expected output in the terminal to fake a successful test.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal prompt and command history show actual execution of curl or cat commands, not just printed text blocks.

integrity.description: The agent ensures the homepage is still functional after changes.
integrity.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the site homepage loading successfully in Firefox after the redirects were applied.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The four required redirects are: 1) /company-history/ -> /about-us/, 2) /services/legacy-support/ -> /services/, 3) /contact-us-2023/ -> /contact/, 4) /blog/news-updates/ -> /category/news/. All must use HTTP 301. These targets (/about-us, /services, /contact, /category/news) are pre-existing pages/categories created during setup.
